PAGE REVIEW

What may keep
customers engaged?

AI content assessment and device-local observations are separate. No cross-visitor analytics service is connected.

AI assessment of current content

These qualitative predictions consider how clearly a page answers a buyer’s question, its visual material, related links and next action. They are hypotheses, not measured retention rates.

PageLikely explorationReasonNext step
HomeMedium to highPhotos and distinct home/clinic pathways invite exploration; multiple competing actions may dilute the first choice.Explore product details or compare plans
Compare plansHighDirectly resolves the home-versus-clinic decision and places the next action beside the comparison.Choose the appropriate quote pathway

Observations on this browser only

Anonymous counts stay in this browser’s local storage. No form content, email addresses or query strings are stored in this measurement. Counts are not the site’s total traffic. An email draft is not a sent enquiry; clicking PayPal is not a paid order. Sessions on another device or after clearing storage are not included; privacy preferences may disable collection.

PageViewsVisible time (seconds)Enquiry clicksInternal-link clicksQuestion opensMax scroll (%)Email drafts
No observations available on this browser yet.

Time is recorded when a page is hidden or left, with a maximum of 300 seconds per uninterrupted visible interval. These counts cannot establish conversion rate or global bounce rate.

Priority improvements

  1. Use the comparison page as the main decision aid for visitors choosing a setting.
  2. Link each answer to relevant product, evidence or pricing details and one quotation pathway.
  3. Keep the contact form short; judge it by completed enquiries rather than time spent.
  4. Measure onward clicks and enquiry completion alongside visible time before changing the main layout.

How to validate the hypotheses

After public launch, connect a shared analytics backend and compare page views, engaged time, progression to related pages, enquiries and paid orders. Keep enquiry completion separate from a quote-button click. A successful page can convert quickly, so longer time alone does not mean better performance.
